runs.t: Which description best captures the main purpose of

options.text: Clean Architecture organizes code around business policies that do not depend on frameworks, databases, or UI details.

Layered Architecture divides an application into presentation, business/application logic, and data access responsibilities.

runs.t: An AI agent works on this task:
In a hotel booking flow, the use case checks availability, applies cancellation policy, and requests persistence through a repository port.
Which proposed verification task most directly tests the required behavior?

options.text: Design a booking-confirmed event and two independent consumers. Ask the agent to demonstrate duplicate delivery, consumer retry, schema versioning and an outbox failure case.
Ask an agent to implement a cancel-booking use case with a persistence port, HTTP adapter, and business-rule tests. Require dependency arrows and an explanation of why each boundary exists.
Have an agent extract loyalty rules from ORM models into a domain core. Demand tests that run without the database and an integration test for persistence mapping.
Have an agent produce a context map for hotel reservations, CRM, and payments using a supplied glossary. Challenge ambiguous terms and derive two aggregate invariants before implementation.
